2. 'texture_anomaly' (Severity 1): Supported by visual inspection. The key legends show slight warping. The `perceptual_quality_auditor` missed this because it focuses on global distortions (blur/noise), not local text geometry.
3. 'structural_collapse' (Severity 1): The Router noted edge softness. The `topology_boundary_auditor` gave a high confidence score (0.97), suggesting the main body is coherent. However, the 'scattered type' pieces in the foreground likely have poor boundary integrity (melting into the wood) which the topology auditor didn't explicitly segment separately. I will maintain Severity 2 for the text/foreground area as it represents a cluster of minor structural/text failures.

No new catastrophic artifacts were found. The `fine_grained_classifier` strongly confirms the class label (Logit 7.89 vs 6.34 for next best), overriding any minor geometric deviations.
